text:
anna: quick idea: add a "soft ramp" intent that the control plane emits for short bursts. aim: reduce cold-start p95 without changing autoscaler core.

liam: short tl;dr?

anna: control-plane watches qps derivative + p95. on spike it emits intent: tenant, requested_slices, duration, ramp_curve. operator can ack/partial/deny. intents are time-boxed.

rohit: sounds similar to prewarm but dynamic. how do we prevent waste?

anna: budget cap per-tenant (gpu_seconds). also cooldowns and single active ramp per tenant.

emma: operator side changes minimal?

anna: operator accepts signed intent JWT, tries to pack, writes status back. shim controller converts intent -> operator calls so autoscaler unchanged.

jules: metrics to add: intent_accept_ratio, intent_reject_reasons, post_intent_p95_delta, intent_cost_by_tenant.

liam: rollout plan?

anna: 1) intent schema + sign/verify 2) operator status path 3) simulate "would_apply" mode 4) canary on dev pools opt-in 5) expand.

rohit: edge: multiple tenants ramping together. arbitration by priority_weight then round-robin. add fair-share guard.

emma: security: verify JWT nonce and issuer, ops approves.

jules: testing: loadgen bursts + mixed model packing. capture cases where ramp helped and where it wasted.

ops-bot: FYI: canary deploy window 20:00 UTC might impact tests :calendar:.

liam: sounds reasonable. anna, can you draft a one-pager and config example?

anna: will share RFC today. ACTIONS: anna write RFC, rohit scope operator shim, jules add dashboards, liam design load tests.

emma: :thumbsup: start opt-in for pools; default off for enterprise.

anna: tagging @liam @rohit @jules for follow-up.
